get.description: This endpoint returns a list of your External Connections inside the 'data' attribute of the response. External Connections are used by Telnyx customers to seamless configure SIP trunking integrations with Telnyx Partners, through External Voice Integrations in Mission Control Portal.

post.description: Creates a new External Connection based on the parameters sent in the request. The external_sip_connection and outbound voice profile id are required. Once created, you can assign phone numbers to your application using the `/phone_numbers` endpoint.
